eyebrow: What a Deployment deliberately gives up

steps.label: No "the third one"
steps.sub: scaling down can remove any replica

steps.label: Fine for stateless apps
steps.sub: wrong for a clustered database with distinct replica roles

code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  serviceName: postgres
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template: { ... }
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: pgdata
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: managed-premium-retain
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi
caption: volumeClaimTemplates stamps out one PVC per replica, not one shared volume.

eyebrow: One PVC per Pod, by name
code:
kubectl get pvc
# pgdata-postgres-0   Bound   20Gi
# pgdata-postgres-1   Bound   20Gi
# pgdata-postgres-2   Bound   20Gi

# delete + recreate postgres-1 ->
# rebinds to pgdata-postgres-1, same data
caption: postgres-1 never touches postgres-0's disk — identity and storage stay paired.
